_about: VIP aircraft: each rule's fields (hex, reg, callsign, type, operator, tags) are regular expressions that must all match; the first rule that matches gives the label. reg is compared without dashes or spaces. Who is aboard is never broadcast, so labels say who the aircraft is used for. Changing this file relabels every stored flight on the next start.
